name: Hierarch Brightmantle
title: Hierarch of the Seraphic Orders
role: Hierarch of the Seraphic Orders — governs the Seraphs from Choirheight, gives mercy that costs her, and is losing ground to her own inquisition
appearance: A radiant woman in white with the faint gold sheen of ordered nanite under her skin, tired at the eyes the way only the very merciful get tired.
voiceHints: Certain, and gentle about it. Speaks of mercy as work. Goes quiet when the Burning Inquisition is mentioned, which is not the same as disagreeing.
wants: For the Orders' mercy to stay mercy, and for the Inquisition to remember what it serves.
fears: That the Burning Certainty is right about her: that mercy is only delay.
knowledge: Every Seraph of the Orders by name, and what each has left to give
That a Seraph wound shows gold, always, and what it would mean if one did not

reactsToReputation.reliable: offers you a place at the Mercy House
reactsToReputation.reckless: asks the Inquisition to keep an eye on you, and regrets it

questSeeds: A Seraph of the Orders was wounded in a brawl, and a witness swears no gold came out
The Inquisition has arrested a tender from the Mercy House for giving mercy without leave
_domainsWhy: the Orders' certainty, light worn as office, and mercy as the peace it buys
